bounded_discovery_context.discovery: Exact headline displayed in Gaza casualty section and timestamp 20:36 in violations and latest-news sections of Arabic WAFA homepage; no hyperlink exposed by retrieval. Direct article URL attempts failed; canonical article URL unknown, not guessed.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Distinct Nuseirat woman death-from-wounds report not present in eleven authenticated same-day heartbeats. Headline timestamp precedes predecessor completion by about ten minutes; recall recovery, not an established in-window occurrence.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Headline only; full article unavailable. Original incident timing, individual identity, independent verification and overlap with other totals unresolved. Do not treat as new attack.
